statement: For an open orbit of an ambient-null plane centralizer loop, compactness of its quotient by the actual closed proper operator image and at most two actual lifted boundary-quotient partitions give a jointly continuous contraction on the whole orbit closure, with jointly continuous inverse and the exact median frontier prescription. An empty partition family forces every frontier orbit to be fixed. These contractions transport under the original operators and paste with the full nonopen median contraction over every finite union of the indicated closures.
depends_on: C30 free proper closed operator image and open Polish orbit map; C32-C33 intrinsic null-homotopy; C34 full nonopen median continuity and inverse; C42 exact Map_L evaluation homeomorphism; C46-C48 simultaneous full quotient equations; compact fundamental set and actual-operator approximation
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), infinite-operator zero-level comparison and ambient frontier extension
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. Cocompactness is explicitly the compactness of O/Q_O for the actual closure of the restrictions of the original stabilizing operator group. No global extension of an arbitrary member of that closure is assumed.
notes: Write a frontier sequence as q_n y_n with y_n in one compact fundamental set. Approximate q_n on that set and all its contraction and inverse images by actual global operators h_n. The open L orbit map gives l_n approaching identity with l_n y=y_n. Commutation yields h_n y approaching the frontier point. C42 evaluation then gives compact-open convergence to an actual boundary quotient, identified with the original fixed-basepoint family by an exact formula. The full quotient equation forces the limit of the contraction, and the inverse argument is identical. This proves whole-closure continuity for the specified cocompact subcase, including empty quotient families. Infinite unions across different fundamental sets and agreement with the exponential X_star prescription remain unproved.
